scope: Public, read-only research. Hyperliquid Core/EVM activity, representative LP economics, stablecoin/TVL/lending stocks; Ethereum capital and BTC/ETH/HYPE market context. Not an exhaustive chain, wallet or cross-exchange flow audit.

limits: Explorer-produced daily aggregates, not independent full-node replay.
Addresses are not people; new addresses are not active users.
Gas consumed is not capacity utilization; HyperEVM transactions exclude HyperCore order actions.

capital.method: Latest common provider-dated stock record. Dates are provider labels, not independently audited update times. Differencing known stocks is valid; no claim that current UTC-day flows are complete. Stock change is not proven net deposits.

dex_3venue_fee_aggregate.scope: Project X, nest CL, HyperSwap V3. Fees minus provider-defined revenue; no emissions, inventory PnL, impermanent loss, gas or hedging costs included.

core_and_market_comparisons.validation: All 11 fee/volume/revenue series have unique timestamps, finite non-null observations for every one of the same 14 UTC dates. No partial Sep21 flows used.

method.comparison: Sep 14-20 2026 UTC (7 complete days) versus Sep 7-13 UTC (prior 7 complete days)
method.partial_day_excluded: Sep 21 2026 UTC; Project X chart contains it and API was fetched during that day. Nest CL and HyperSwap V3 latest daily row is Sep 20.
method.scope: Project X, nest CL, and HyperSwap V3 only. No HyperEVM whole-chain/pool-volume endpoint is used, avoiding route/bridge double counting.
method.tvl: Mean of the seven UTC-midnight protocol TVL observations matched to each volume window; not a contemporaneous pool-TV L estimate.
method.lp_fees: Implied supply-side fees = DefiLlama fees minus DefiLlama revenue. This is a period cash-flow proxy, not annualized APY and excludes token-reward price/inflation assumptions.

coverage_limits: The three named DEX deployments are not a chain-total DEX measure: excluded examples include HyperSwap V2 and nest AMM.
DeFiLlama's reported revenue is protocol/token-holder revenue, not necessarily distributable LP yield; use the per-protocol methodology in raw responses.
Project X's protocol TVL endpoint is substantially broader than the two quoted LP pools; it is used only as the explicit protocol-level denominator.

funding.caveat: Current/premium rates and constant-rate scenarios are indicators, not funding forecasts.
Current/premium rates and constant-rate scenarios are indicators, not funding forecasts.
Current/premium rates and constant-rate scenarios are indicators, not funding forecasts.

limitations: Descriptive current-market metrics, not forecasts or trade instructions.
HYPE spot (Bybit candles) lacks taker-buy quote data; it is kept null.
Support/resistance are recent observed high/low ranges, not validated trading levels.

limits: Stablecoin supply, bridge balances and TVL are stocks, not traced external deposits.
Core/EVM internal transfers are not cross-chain inflow; avoid double counting wrappers and underlying collateral.
Current UTC-day volume/fees/gas/transactions excluded from completed 7-day flow comparisons; stock observations use explicit provider date labels.
Daily active users and bot-adjusted organic usage remain unverified.
Provider revenue is not independent proof of actual token-buy execution; fees are not net LP PnL.
Market figures refer to the recorded capture, not a live feed or a validated return forecast.

method.dates: same UTC-midnight stock records; Sep21 00:00 is a stock record, not a flow total
method.interpretation_limit: Quantity effect is a change in reported token balance, not proof of net deposits, withdrawals, leverage, or rehypothecation. USD valuation and token reporting methodology can affect both terms.
method.residual_policy: New/removed/missing/zero-quantity symbols are left as residual, never force-allocated. Token USD sum is separately reconciled to protocol TVL.
method.symbol_limit: The source maps are keyed by symbol, with no contract address in these rows. There are no duplicate map keys to exclude, but a cross-contract symbol collision cannot be independently detected and no claim is made that symbols are unique assets.
